AUDITED is reserved for an explicit final card-level audit, not a historical completion note.

rulingQuestions.question: When an opponent with4 hand cards destroys Adansonhaetori while Ashinagagumo is on the defeated controller's field, can resolving Predation first (opponent territory draw→hand5) enable Flycatcher's hand-discard effect? Is the conditional hand threshold fixed at destruction/trigger registration or checked when resolving the ordered effect?
rulingQuestions.canonicalStatusPolicy: SET5-7 stays PARTIAL, never PLAYABLE, until this interaction is established. Existing SET3-15 declaration is not a certificate for this unavailable-card combination.
rulingQuestions.currentCode: Provisional shared legacy destruction ability resolution checks its condition when resolving. This is not asserted as the official answer for the new combination.
rulingQuestions.confirmed: Official SET5 QA establishes two Predation watchers cause two territory draws. General official simultaneous-effect rules allow same-controller order selection. They did not establish the conditional-threshold timing in the searched material.
